## Summary

A one-sentence description of what you want.

## Motivation

Why is this useful? What problem does it solve? What use case are you trying to cover?

## Proposed interface

If this adds a CLI flag or changes behaviour, describe what you'd expect:

```bash
petrify input.mp4 output.mp4 --my-new-flag value
```

## Alternatives considered

Have you tried working around this with existing flags? What didn't work?

## Additional context

Links to related issues, prior art, papers, or tools that do something similar.
